Death visits every cold, unguarded night, leaving behind souls weeping in sorrow.
They mourn everything they held dear in this world. Even their most beautiful dreams were left behind.

Other Additions
  • Adds Set 51 of "Paimon's Paintings" chat emojis.
  • Adds some prompts for loading screens.
  • Another 2 sets of Artifacts are available to exchange in the Mystic Offering system: Night of the Sky's Unveiling and Silken Moon's Serenade.
  • Adds some of the Harvestable seeds from Snezhnaya to the Seed Dispensary.
  • Adds Series II of "Valiant Chronicles," featuring 3 new Local Legends and the corresponding challenges introduced in this version: Bandersnatch, Churin, and Furiosa. Complete the required number of challenges to obtain the "First Snow" avatar frame.
  • The August 10, 2026 update to "To Temper Thyself and Journey Far" expands the selection of available Stella Fortuna, adding Stella Fortuna for the following characters: Lyney, Wriothesley, Navia, Xianyun, Chiori, Sigewinne, Clorinde, Emilie, and Yumemizuki Mizuki.
  • After the Version 7.0 update, "Long-Term Encounter Points" will be reset. Travelers, please take note.
Imaginarium Theater
  • Update Scheduled for September 1
    • After the Version 7.0 update, a new season of Imaginarium Theater will be available on September 1, 2026.
    • Required Elemental Types: Hydro, Electro, and Dendro
    • Opening Characters: Columbina, Xingqiu, Cyno, Kuki Shinobu, Lauma, and Kaveh
    • When Imaginarium Theater is open, the corresponding Opening Characters will obtain Fantastical Blessings.
    • Special Guest Stars: Odette, Sandrone, Sucrose, and Nicole
    • After the new season of Imaginarium Theater begins, the characters Flins, Columbina, Kirara, and Illuga will each gain a new "Thespian Trick" that can be exchanged from the NPC Wolfy.
  • Envisaged Echoes Update
    • After the Version 7.0 update, new challenge stages and Echo cosmetics for Tartaglia and Xiao will be added.* Envisaged Echoes Update
      • Echo: Childe (Tartaglia)
      • Echo: Vigilant Yaksha (Xiao)
Spiral Abyss
  • Update Scheduled for August 16
    • After the Version 7.0 update, Phase 1 of the Spiral Abyss will be updated on August 16.
    • Floor 9 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
      • Characters' Stellar Swirl DMG increased by 50%.
    • Floor 10 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
      • Characters' Stellar-Conduct DMG increased by 50%.
    • Floor 11 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
      • All party members receive a 60% Cryo DMG Bonus.
      • All party members gain a 60% Pyro DMG Bonus.
    • Floor 12 Ley Line Disorders changed to:
      • First Half: Characters' Superconduct DMG increased by 200% and Stellar-Conduct DMG increased by 75%.
      • Second Half: Characters' Normal Attack Pyro DMG increased by 75%.
    • Updated the monster lineup on Floors 9, 10, 11, and 12 of the Spiral Abyss.
    • Blessing of the Abyssal Moon: Luster-Piercing Moon
      • While the active character is inside a Polestar Field, when they deal DMG to opponents, their attacks will unleash a shockwave at the opponent's position that deals True DMG. This can trigger once every 4s.
    • Starting from this edition of Spiral Abyss, the "Disenchantment in Deep Shadow" and "Celestial Gift" Artifact set rewards in Domain Reliquary: Tier I and Domain Reliquary: Tier II obtained from the Ley Lines on Floors 9–12 will be replaced with the "Scarlet Proof" and the "Heart of the Furnace" sets.
  • Update Scheduled for September 16
    • After the Version 7.0 update, Phase 2 of the Spiral Abyss will be updated on September 16.
    • Floor 11 Ley Line Disorder changed to:
    • All party members gain a 60% Anemo DMG Bonus.
    • All party members gain a 60% Electro DMG Bonus.
    • Floor 12 Ley Line Disorders changed to:
      • First Half: Characters' Swirl DMG increased by 200% and Stellar Swirl DMG increased by 75%.
      • Second Half: Characters' Electro-Charged DMG increased by 200% and Lunar-Charged DMG increased by 75%.
    • Updated the monster lineup on Floors 11 – 12 of the Spiral Abyss.
    • Blessing of the Abyssal Moon: Cascading Moon
      • When a character deals Swirl or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, a shockwave will be unleashed at the opponent's position, dealing True DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
Miliastra Wonderland
  • Cosmetic Sets
    • The "Phantasmagoric Discourse" Event Ode brings 4 new sets: "Whimsical Spectacle," "Azure Mountainshade," "Sleuth's Verdict," and "Twilight Phantom Thief."
    • "Chronicles of the Realms"/"Epic of the Realms" features 3 new sets: "Letter Crane Courier," "Scary Cat," and "Precision Strike."
    • Available for a limited time only from the Miliastra Shop: 3 new sets. They are "Cloudbound Journey/Cloudbound Flight," "Fun Under Open Skies," and "Warrior of the Winning Hand."
    • "Encounter Echoes" Standard Ode: 1 new Set Catalog, "Crowned by the Breeze," is available.
    • Take part in the "Raiment Collection: Gentle Warmth" event to obtain the new "Amber Nectar" set.
    • After the version update, the set "Dreamy Summer Leisure" that was obtainable through an earlier limited-time event will be available for a limited time at the Miliastra Shop.
  • Lobby
    • With the new version update, the Public Lobby will be changed to a new theme: "Miracle Theater: Dreamcraft."
    • Travelers can purchase the new Private Lobby "Miracle Theater: Light and Shadow Spectacle" through the Miliastra Pass.
  • Wonderlands
    • Adds the "Wonderland Rising Stars" section, which showcases the latest creations and updates from Craftspeople.
    • Adds the "Wonderland Topic" section, featuring regularly updated selections of Wonderland stages curated around specific themes.
    • Adds replies to stage comments. Comments now show how long the commenter had played the stage when posting, as well as whether the stage was in Early Access at the time. The stage details page now displays the stage's recommendation rate over the past 30 days, calculated from comments posted during that period.
    • The new version also adds additional cosmetic components, expressions, and special effects.
    • For updates regarding the "Miliastra Wonderland" stage editor and Miliastra Sandbox, Travelers can check "My Miliastra Wonderland" > "Notices."

Adjustments & Optimizations[]

  • Increased the maximum number of Artifacts stored in the Inventory from 2,400 to 2,700.
Quests
  1. Adds a teleportation function for quest objectives: Some quest objective locations now support teleportation. Select a supported objective on the "Map" screen and click the "Go" button to teleport to the quest objective or a nearby location. (This feature initially applies to certain quests in the Version 7.0 update. Future versions expand support to more new quests and further optimize the feature.)
Enemies
  1. Optimizes how attempts are counted for the related "Valiant Chronicles" challenge objective to: "Before the Prism Slime first gathers light and swells, make sure it attempts to absorb energy no more than 2 times," so that the count more accurately reflects the enemy's skill actions.
Exploration
  1. Adjusts how Multi-Layered Maps are displayed on the "Map" screen to prevent the layouts of unexplored areas from being revealed prematurely and affecting the gameplay experience: A Multi-Layered Map and its corresponding button now appear only after the Traveler has reached or unlocked the relevant area (before this adjustment, Multi-Layered Maps were always visible). If the corresponding area contains a tracked point, including a tracked Teleport Waypoint, the Multi-Layered Map and its button remain visible.
  2. Optimizes the display logic when the "Luna Treasure Compass" and "Segment-Domain Treasure Compass" mark clues: Increases the display priority of Oculus icons to prevent them from being obscured by other icons. (The "Cryo Treasure Compass" introduced in Version 7.0 also incorporates this optimization.)
  3. Increases the pin limit on the Map from 300 to 350.
Adventurer Handbook
  1. Optimizes the sorting logic on the "Domains" page of the Adventurer Handbook: All Domains are now consistently sorted based on the version in which they were added and their unlock status, with unlocked Domains from more recent versions appearing higher in the list.
Inventory
  1. Increases the combined Inventory capacity for Character Development Items, Food, Materials, Gadgets, Quest Items, and Precious Items from 2,300 to 2,600.
  2. Increases the maximum number of Artifacts that can be stored in the Inventory from 2,400 to 2,700.
Audio
  1. Optimizes the sound effects in certain scenes, interfaces, and quests.
  2. Optimizes Chinese and Japanese voice-over lines in certain quests.
Other
  1. Adds gyroscope support for certain Android devices that do not have a magnetometer but support a gyroscope.
  2. Adjusts the visual effects of "Stellar-Conduct" and "Starlight Prism" when Graphics Quality is set to "Low" or "Lowest" to reduce performance load.
Genius Invokation TCG Balance Adjustment
  1. Adjusts the number of Elemental Dice required and DMG dealt by the Elemental Skill of the Character Card "Ifa": The Elemental Dice cost is adjusted from 2 Anemo Dice to 3, and the DMG dealt is adjusted from 1 Anemo DMG to 2 Anemo DMG.
  2. Adjusts the Radiant Hues enhancement effect "Radiant Hues: Swift Shadow" for the Elemental Skill of the Character Card "Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker." Its effect is adjusted to: "When you play Radiant Hues: Grant a random highest-cost card in your Hand Cost Reduction equal to the number of stacks of this status."
  3. Adjusts the Elemental Skill effect of the Character Card "Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker": Effect changed to "Deal 1 Cryo DMG, and place 1 Radiant Hues third from the top of your deck. If this is one of the first 4 times this skill is being used this game, then select 1 of 3 random Radiant Hues enhancement effects."
  4. Adjusts the effects of "Tonatiuh," a card generated by the Adventure effect. When Adventure Experience reaches 2, its effect is adjusted to "Draw 1 card." The DMG dealt by "Tide-Turning Sacred Lord" is adjusted to 3 Piercing DMG.
  5. Adjusts the effect of the Event Card "In Every House a Stove" when played in the first Round. Its effect is adjusted to: "If your deck initially contains at least 4/2 different Talent Cards, draw 2/1 Talent Cards."

Bug Fixes[]

Quests
  1. Fixes an issue where, sometimes under certain circumstances, the character would be teleported to an incorrect location and end up falling in an endless loop during the objective "Flee from the spinning turbine" in the World Quest "Visitors From the Stars."
Enemies
  1. Fixes an issue where the visual effects for certain attacks performed by the enemy "Ruin Hunter" would display incorrectly.
  2. Fixes an issue where the camera would behave abnormally when Sandrone used her Elemental Skill while the enemy Millennial Pearl Seahorse's Xenomare Pearl was damaged.
  3. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the enemy "Prism Slime" became stuck underground when disengaging from combat, with no way to reset its state.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the enemy "Moosh-Tehir" behaves abnormally when using skills.
  5. Fixes an issue whereby the enemy "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" is unaffected by characters' taunting skills.
  6. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there is a small chance that Detection Devices deployed by the enemy "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" disappear unexpectedly.
Characters
  1. Fixes an issue where, when Sandrone's Charged Attack was canceled and she changed direction, some of Fagio's skill effects would also follow her new orientation in error.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, there is a chance that the animation for the first hit of Sandrone's Normal Attack stutters abnormally when she performs consecutive Normal Attacks.
  3. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Elemental RES reduction effect of Venti's Constellation 6 would sometimes not take effect.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby, after Citlali equips the outfit "Whispers of Stars and Smoke," Citlalin's movement trajectory becomes abnormal when the Jump button is held to perform a leap.
  5. Fixes an issue whereby, following the Version Luna VIII update, there is a chance that the shield generated by Diona's Elemental Skill has an abnormal duration.
  6. Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the ribbon on Aether's outfit "As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew" clips through his hair.
  7. Fixes an issue whereby there is a chance that the ribbons on Lumine's outfits "As Heaven and Earth Are Made Anew" and "Rising Star" clip through her character model.
  8. Fixes an issue whereby, on mobile devices, certain lighting effects are missing from Lohen's Elemental Burst animation.
  9. Fixes an issue whereby, in Co-Op Mode, when multiple Travelers are each using Yae Miko and have unlocked the Talent "Edict of Cleansing," there is a chance that enhanced Sesshou Sakura lightning strikes fail to trigger the additional Electro DMG provided by the "Radiance: Stellar-Conduct" effect upon hitting enemies.
  10. . Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, after Cyno unlocks the Additional Talent "A Star With Which to Start the Journey," there is a chance that an abnormal number of Elemental Particles are generated when his Elemental Skill hits an enemy.
  11. . Fixes an issue whereby abnormal visual effects remain in Illuga's hands after he uses his Elemental Skill by holding the Skill button.
Audio
  1. Fixes an error in the Chinese voice-over for the dialogue option "How do you like it here?" when interacting with Sandrone in the Serenitea Pot.
  2. Fixes an error in a voice-over line in the Archon Quests "As All Falls to Emptiness" and "Ancient Shadows Re-Emerge."
  3. Fixes an issue where, following the Version "Luna VIII" update, the Chinese voice-over for certain lines was missing from Yelan's Travelers' Tales.
  4. Restores certain related voice-over lines that were missing whenever Columbina performed the first hit of her Normal Attack.
Miliastra Wonderland
  1. Fixes an issue whereby, when using a keyboard and mouse on PC, there is a chance that some key inputs fail to register if multiple keys are pressed simultaneously in Miliastra Wonderland stages.
Serenitea Pot
  1. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, characters would clip into the furnishing "Ripples in Miniature."
  2. Fixes an issue where the model of the furnishing "Keys of Ingenuity" was inconsistent with its icon and the model displayed in the "Sunny Summer Fontinalia" event.
System
  1. Fixes an issue whereby certain settings changes made while playing "Repertoire of Myriad Melodies" are not saved after logging back in.
  2. Fixes an issue whereby character facial shading displays abnormally on the "Character" screen.
  3. Fixes an issue where, under certain circumstances, the Element of the Traveler was displayed incorrectly in the "Challenge Record" screen during Stygian Onslaught gameplay.
  4. Fixes an issue on mobile devices where, after using a controller to navigate from the "Settings" to the "Pre-Install" screen, players were then unable to exit the corresponding screen.
  5. Fixes an issue in certain screens or scenes where switching to characters wearing their new outfits (specifically Citlali's "Whispers of Stars and Smoke" and Charlotte's "Hurlock Variations") might occasionally cause minor lags.
  6. Fixes an issue in the "Equipment" and Weapon > Enhance screens where the weapon "Ballad of the Fjords" would display with an incorrect height.
Other
  1. Fixes an issue in Imaginarium Theater whereby, when the duration of certain stacks of the Brilliant Blessing "Bloom: Core Condensation" expires, there is a chance that all stacks are incorrectly cleared.
  2. Fixes text errors in certain quests, interfaces, dialogues and descriptions.
  3. Fixes an issue whereby the gadget "Sandrone's Portable Tea Table" can be placed inside the Knights of Favonius Headquarters when it should not be.
  4. Fixes an issue whereby, under certain circumstances, when selecting "Send Invitation" while using the gadget "Sandrone's Portable Tea Table," there is a chance that the "Cancel Quest" button is also activated.
  5. Fixes an issue where the gadget "Sandrone's Portable Tea Table" could be placed while clipping through terrain and locations.
  6. Fixes an issue whereby, on certain mobile devices or on PCs with Graphics Quality set to "Low" or "Lowest," certain particle effects persist abnormally after Sandrone uses a Charged Attack.
  7. Fixes some text errors in certain languages and optimizes text. (Note: Related in-game functions have not changed. Travelers can view the changes in different languages by going to the Paimon Menu > Settings > Language and changing the Game Language.)
    • Optimizes inconsistencies between certain voice-overs and the corresponding lines.
    • Optimizes certain English translations.

Known Issues[]

  1. Currently, in a cutscene for the Archon Quest "Wraith's Nocturne," the Elemental Type icon displayed for Mitya appears incorrect (it should be an Electro "Stellar Linchpin"). This issue will be fixed in a future update.
  2. Currently, PC devices equipped with Intel® Iris® Xe series graphics cards may experience abnormal screen flickering when entering the Snezhnaya region.
    Travelers who encounter this issue are advised to visit the Intel official website to download and install the latest graphics driver, then restart their device to resolve the issue.
    Travelers can also visit the following link for detailed instructions on updating Intel drivers:
    https://www.hoyolab.com/article/20981435
  3. Currently, certain Landrover and Fatui Oprichniki opponents can still fire their weapons while Frozen or Petrified (including in the Spiral Abyss, the open world, Shadow Realms, etc.). This issue will be fixed in the Version 7.1 update.

Post-patch Optimization & Fixes[]

2026-08-13 16:10 UTC+8
  1. Fixes an issue in the "Test Run" event where the description related to Stellar-Conduct reactions contained errors.
    The incorrect text read: "...the [Polestar] field will store the dissipating elemental energies and then completely release them every 3s. This further increases the aforementioned DMG Bonus and also increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG coefficient for 3s."
